You can warm or gently melt things, but it is not suitable for real cooking or slow cooking from raw.

What chafing dishes + fuel are actually designed to do
Chafing fuel (gel or wick cans) is engineered to:

Hold pre-cooked food at serving temperature

Maintain ~140–165°F (60–74°C) in the pan

Run very low and steady heat for hours
